## Canned ollaya responder (fallback path)

ACTIVATE this workflow (top-right toggle) - webhooks only listen while active.

It answers POST /webhook/canned-ollaya exactly like ollaya's /api/decide, picking a canned response by matching the ticket text. Unknown tickets get the low-confidence answer (routes to human_review - correct behavior).

Then change ONE field in the demo workflow: in **Laya Decide (System 1)** (and **Ollaya Decide** in the choice PoC), point the URL from
  http://host.docker.internal:11435/api/decide
to
  http://host.docker.internal:5678/webhook/canned-ollaya
(On Linux use http://localhost:5678/... if host.docker.internal does not resolve.)

Nothing else changes - same workflow, same routing logic, same output fields.
